lines.text: Many learners say: She is very good in math.
Better: She is very good at math.
The first! He is good at English.

data.wrong: She is very good in math.
data.right: She is very good at math.

native.tip: Para dizer que alguém é bom em algo, use “good at”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “She is very good in math.” O certo é “She is very good at math.” Em português dizemos “bom em matemática”, mas em inglês usamos “at”. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “He is good at English.” Agora diga em voz alta uma frase sua com esse ponto e treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: To say someone is skilled at something, use “good at”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “She is very good in math.” The right way is “She is very good at math.” In Portuguese we say “bom em matemática”, but English uses “at”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
